persons.name: Mathurānātharāma
persons.evidence: mathurānātharāmeṇa śi(!)ghraṃ, nakṣatrāṇāñ ca mālāṃ janahitakam idam pustakañ cālilekha

date.as_written: naipālikābde nabharasavivare cāśvine māsi kṛṣṇe paṃcamyāṃ rohiṇy ṛkṣe śaradṛtuguravoḥ (!) bhānuge san tulāyāṃ (!) [...] 960 samvat

notes: The chronogram 'nabharasavivara' denotes 960 (nabha = 0, rasa = 6, vivara = 9). The catalogue lists the scribe's name simply as Mathurānātha, but the text reads 'mathurānātharāmeṇa'.
